hydraulicModel.assetStrategy: time-based one-hour crest release over precomputed one-foot-grid hydraulic lookups

scenarioMethod: Estimated non-exceedance percentiles from PETSS station TWL (ensemble mean) and TWL90p (10th non-exceedance percentile), assuming a normal lower-tail shape; p25 is interpolated, p01 extrapolated, and p50 approximated by TWL. These are not published NOAA percentile products or absolute bounds.
